stem.text: A projectile is launched at an angle above horizontal ground and travels through the air.

stem.alt: Path of a projectile launched above horizontal ground, with a point X at the top of the path, labelled projectile, path of the projectile and ground.

stem.text: The projectile reaches its maximum height at position X. Assume that no upthrust acts on the projectile.
Which diagram shows the **directions** of the force or forces acting on the projectile at position X?

A.alt: A horizontal arrow pointing right and a vertical arrow pointing down, meeting at a corner.

B.alt: A horizontal arrow pointing left and a vertical arrow pointing down, meeting at a corner.

C.alt: A single horizontal arrow pointing right.

D.alt: A vertical double-headed arrow with one head pointing up and one head pointing down.
